C0597.title: Lao Gan Ma Trade Secret Theft Case
keywords: Lao Gan Ma trade secret theft
C0597.summary: In May 2016, Lao Gan Ma discovered that a local competitor was producing highly similar products. Investigation confirmed that its core manufacturing technology had been stolen.
